t: A tiny, cheap Wi-Fi camera board for streaming and snapping photos.
steps: Buy an ESP32-CAM bundled with the ESP32-CAM-MB programmer base from a store such as Amazon or Olimex.
Install the Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the ESP32 board package in the Arduino IDE boards manager.
Snap the board onto the programmer base and plug it in with a micro USB cable.
Pick the AI Thinker ESP32-CAM board and open the CameraWebServer example.
Type your Wi-Fi name and password into the example and upload it.
Open the serial monitor to find the board address and visit it in a browser.
Use a good 5 volt power supply to stop brownout resets.
meta: Open Board. From $14.99. A few stores.
